subject: Stakeholder mapping + procurement/legal contacts for Redwood demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenny Alvarez <jenny.alvarez@acme-commerce.com>, Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping + procurement/legal contacts for Redwood demo

Hi Jenny 

Thanks again for the time earlier  appreciate the quick walkthrough of the commerce stack and the latency/cost questions you raised. Per our call I wanted to recap next steps and ask for a couple of items that will help move procurement/legal and the decision process along: 

1) Stakeholder map / org chart: who are the decision makers and influencers across Engineering, Security, Procurement, and Finance? If you have an org chart or a short list (name / title / role in decision) that'd be great. I've attached a one-page stakeholder-mapping template to make this painless.

2) Procurement & legal contacts: can you introduce the procurement lead and the person who owns vendor security reviews / SOC2? If possible cc them so we can share our procurement checklist and SOC2 report.

3) Decision criteria & timeline: you mentioned latency, cost, and security  if there are any other non-negotiables (e.g., on-prem options, encryption/KMS requirements, contract length) please flag them. Also helpful to know target procurement timeline (weeks).

Proposed next steps:
- I'll send a short one-pager on how Redwood handles private deployments, security controls, and typical procurement artifacts.
- If procurement prefers, we can schedule a 30-minute intake with our sales ops + security engineering to walk through vendor setup and required docs.

Thanks  attaching stakeholder-mapping-template.xlsx for ease of completion.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: stakeholder-mapping-template.xlsx

From: Jenny Alvarez <jenny.alvarez@acme-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@acme-commerce.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-commerce.com>, Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + procurement/legal contacts for Redwood demo

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the follow-up and the template  very helpful. Attached is a quick org snapshot and I filled the template with the names I have. High level:

- Economic / Executive sponsor: Mark Daniels, VP Commerce (primary decision maker)
- Technical champion: Jenny Alvarez, Head of AI (me)  evaluating integration & latency tradeoffs
- Procurement contact: Samir Patel (cc'd)  vendor onboarding + SOW/price review
- Legal / Security contact: Laura Jensen (cc'd)  vendor security review, SOC2 evidence

Decision criteria to call out:
- Latency under 150ms p95 for inference on product search paths
- Cost per 1M tokens / ability to cap spend / predictable committed capacity options
- SOC2 Type II, customer-managed KMS for secrets, and audit logging retention for 12 months
- References from commerce customers and a short pilot that demonstrates production traffic patterns

Target timeline: procurement intake + legal review this month; vendor selection in ~4-8 weeks depending on procurement queue. We'd like to get a procurement intake meeting scheduled next week if possible.

Looping in Samir and Laura  Samir, Laura: can you confirm preferred next steps for vendor intake and any docs you need from Redwood? I've attached the org chart we keep internally.

Thanks,

Jenny
Jenny Alvarez
Head of AI, Acme Commerce
jenny.alvarez@acme-commerce.com

Attachments: acme-org-chart.png

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-commerce.com>
To: Jenny Alvarez <jenny.alvarez@acme-commerce.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + procurement/legal contacts for Redwood demo

Hi all 

Thanks for the intro, Jenny. Marissa / Rishi  quick note on procurement process at Acme: 

- Please share a short SOW / project scoping doc and a ballpark pricing estimate for a 3-month pilot (expected throughput: ~50 req/s on peak).
- We require vendor security artifacts up front: SOC2 report, encryption/KMS details, and the procurement checklist (attached for your reference).
- Our procurement intake meeting is a 30-45min session where we validate commercial terms and vendor references  available slots next Tue/Wed morning EST.

If you can send the SOW + SOC2 by EOD Friday our intake team will slot the meeting. I've attached the procurement checklist we use.

Thanks,

Samir Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Commerce
samir.patel@acme-commerce.com

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-commerce.com>, Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-commerce.com>, Jenny Alvarez <jenny.alvarez@acme-commerce.com>, Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + procurement/legal contacts for Redwood demo

Samir / Laura / Jenny / Mark 

Great  thanks for the clarity and the procurement checklist. Next steps from our side: 

1) I've attached a short SOW / pilot scope and a ballpark pricing sheet for a 3-month pilot aligned to the throughput you called out.
2) Attached: Redwood one-pager on security controls and a link to our SOC2 report: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-report. We support customer-managed KMS and per-tenant audit logs; happy to get into specifics during the intake.
3) Proposed intake slots: Tue 10:00-10:45 AM EST or Wed 11:00-11:45 AM EST  please let us know which works or propose alternatives.

If procurement wants an internal technical readout before the intake, Rishi can run a 20-minute demo focused on latency/cost optimizations and deployment options.

Thanks  looking forward to the intake.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
